run_kto_training: run KTO training on a causal language model with a specified dataset and output directory
run_kto_qlora: run KTO training with QLoRA using 4-bit quantization and LoRA adapters on a causal language model
build_kto_parser: build an argparse parser for the KTO training script with TRL dataclass configuration arguments
run_kto_with_peft: run KTO training with PEFT configuration targeting all linear modules for parameter-efficient fine-tuning
run_kto_push_hub: run KTO training and push the trained model to the Hugging Face Hub with a specified dataset name
